1.name: Gate 1 Line 1 - Hidden potential at Source; not yet time to act.
1.asc: Line 1 of a standing wave is first contact with the state being held. At Source (-4), this is initial contact with pure creative potential. "Hidden dragon. Do not act." is precise: at entry to Source, potential is hidden — it has not yet emerged into visibility. Acting would prematurely manifest what must first develop as potential.
1.desc: Keynote: Hidden potential at Source; not yet time to act.

2.name: Gate 1 Line 2 - Creative potential developing definition; connect with aligned sources.
2.asc: Line 2 is development within Source — creative potential becoming more defined. The dragon "appearing in the field" means potential is developing toward visibility while still at Source. "See the great man" = connecting with others at Source. Development at -4 requires resonance with aligned creative fields.
2.desc: Keynote: Creative potential developing definition; connect with aligned sources.

3.name: Gate 1 Line 3 - Internal creative charge at capacity; sustained by drive, threatened by material concerns.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion of internal development — maximum internal creative charge before external expression. The mind "beset with cares" reflects the tension of creative energy seeking outlet. In a standing wave, Line 3 is NOT a threshold to a new domain — it's the peak of internal experience before the same state is expressed externally.
3.desc: Keynote: Internal creative charge at capacity; sustained by drive, threatened by material concerns.

4.name: Gate 1 Line 4 - First external expression of creativity; requires aloneness to remain true to Source.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to external expression of Source creativity. "Wavering flight over the depths" = first externalization is uncertain. The creative impulse has emerged from internal development but hasn't stabilized in expression. "Aloneness as medium" fits precisely: external expression at Source must come from individual creative potential, not from group influence.
4.desc: Keynote: First external expression of creativity; requires aloneness to remain true to Source.

5.name: Gate 1 Line 5 - Creative expression at peak influence; sustained endurance attracts resonance.
5.asc: Line 5 is development of external expression — creativity now visible and influential. "Flying dragon in the heavens" = creative expression fully manifested at Source level, attracting resonance. Still at -4, this isn't form-creation but SOURCE-LEVEL influence — creativity that inspires other creative potentials.
5.desc: Keynote: Creative expression at peak influence; sustained endurance attracts resonance.

6.name: Gate 1 Line 6 - Peak creative expression must remain objective; potential is not yet form.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion of the standing wave — maximum external expression at Source. "Arrogant dragon will have cause to repent" warns against over-extension: creativity at -4 is potential, not form. The standing wave's completion doesn't create anything manifest — it perfects the creative field. Arrogance = believing potential IS manifestation.
6.desc: Keynote: Peak creative expression must remain objective; potential is not yet form.

1.name: Gate 2 Line 1 - First contact with form; intuitive sensing of manifestation beginning.
1.asc: Line 1 of a standing wave at Sink is first contact with maximum form. "Hoarfrost underfoot" = form is already present but not yet fully solid. The Sink pole's density is developing. At +4, entry means recognizing form's presence through subtle signals. Hoarfrost precedes ice — early form precedes full manifestation.
1.desc: Keynote: First contact with form; intuitive sensing of manifestation beginning.

2.name: Gate 2 Line 2 - Developing receptive capacity; natural structure that furthers without purpose.
2.asc: Line 2 is development of receptive capacity at Sink. "Straight, square, great" describes the geometry of stable form — structure without intention. "Without purpose, yet nothing remains unfurthered" = form receives and channels without directing. At +4, development means increasing receptive capacity — becoming more able to receive and hold what arrives.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing receptive capacity; natural structure that furthers without purpose.

3.name: Gate 2 Line 3 - Peak internal receptivity; persevere in service without seeking to initiate.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion of internal development — maximum internal receptive capacity before external expression. "Hidden lines" = internal structure not yet visible. "Seek not works, but bring to completion" = don't initiate, complete what's received. At Sink, Line 3's tension isn't about crossing to a new domain — it's about whether internal receptivity can be maintained as expression begins.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak internal receptivity; persevere in service without seeking to initiate.

4.name: Gate 2 Line 4 - First external expression is containment; discretion without display.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to external expression of Sink receptivity. "Tied-up sack" = external expression is contained, not displayed. "No blame, no praise" = neutral, receptive presence. At +4 externally expressed, the first manifestation is discretion — form that holds without broadcasting.
4.desc: Keynote: First external expression is containment; discretion without display.

5.name: Gate 2 Line 5 - Developed receptive expression; strategic management of what has been received.
5.asc: Line 5 is development of external expression at Sink. "Yellow lower garment" = subtle external adornment, not ostentatious. Yellow is central; lower garment is supportive. Form serves without dominating. At +4, developed external expression means strategic receptivity — intelligently directing received resources.
5.desc: Keynote: Developed receptive expression; strategic management of what has been received.

6.name: Gate 2 Line 6 - Peak receptive expression; tension between form and creative renewal.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion of the standing wave — maximum external expression at Sink. "Dragons fight" = when pure receptivity reaches completion, it clashes with creative force. Black and yellow (yin and yang, Earth and Heaven) = the tension between poles at maximum manifestation. The standing wave's completion at Sink reaches the point where form must either receive new creative input or stagnate.
6.desc: Keynote: Peak receptive expression; tension between form and creative renewal.

1.name: Gate 3 Line 1 - Entry to initiation threshold; hesitation and hindrance — synthesis knows order will emerge.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Gate-IN — first contact with entry initiation in a material circulator. "Hesitation and hindrance, persevere, appoint helpers" = at +1 entry, the beginning is difficult but patience and assistance help. Entry to initiation requires trust that order will emerge. At Gate-IN entry, synthesis knows that order emerges from confusion.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to initiation threshold; hesitation and hindrance — synthesis knows order will emerge.

2.name: Gate 3 Line 2 - Developing at initiation; difficulties pile, ten years waiting — immaturity holds mutation potential.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Gate-IN — building capacity in entry initiation. "Difficulties pile up, horse and wagon part, not robber but wooer, ten years delay" = at +1 development, progress seems blocked. Development at Gate-IN requires long patience. At Gate-IN development, immaturity holds potential for individual mutation.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at initiation; difficulties pile, ten years waiting — immaturity holds mutation potential.

3.name: Gate 3 Line 3 - Peak Gate-IN before transition; without forester, lost — survival knows fertile from sterile.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Gate-IN — peak entry initiation before moving to current. "Hunting deer without forester, loses way, desist, going on humiliates" = at pre-transition, proceeding without guidance fails. The movement to +2 requires proper support. At +1 completion, survival knows what is fertile versus sterile.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Gate-IN before transition; without forester, lost — survival knows fertile from sterile.

4.name: Gate 3 Line 4 - Entry to flowing form; strive for union — charisma attracts nourishment.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Current after transition. "Horse and wagon part, strive for union, going fortunate, everything furthers" = at +2 entry, separation occurred but reunion is favored. Entry to flow after Gate-IN brings support. At Current entry, charisma attracts nourishment for ordering.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to flowing form; strive for union — charisma attracts nourishment.

5.name: Gate 3 Line 5 - Developing at flowing form; moderate effort succeeds — victimisation withstands confusion.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Current — building capacity in flowing form. "Difficulties in blessing, little perseverance good, great perseverance bad" = at +2 development, moderate effort succeeds but excessive effort fails. Development at Current requires balance. At Current development, victimisation withstands confusion through individual energy.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at flowing form; moderate effort succeeds — victimisation withstands confusion.

6.name: Gate 3 Line 6 - Completion at flowing form; bloody tears flow — surrender accepts ordering as process.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Current — the material journey complete. "Horse and wagon part, bloody tears" = at +2 completion, separation and grief. Complete flow brings the recognition of what was lost. At Current completion, surrender accepts that ordering is a process.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at flowing form; bloody tears flow — surrender accepts ordering as process.

1.name: Gate 4 Line 1 - Entry to flowing form; discipline develops the fool — pleasure recognizes natural timing.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Current — first contact with flowing form in a material circulator. "Make fool develop through discipline, remove fetters" = at +2 entry, structure is needed for development but not bondage. Entry to flow requires appropriate guidance. At Current entry, pleasure recognizes natural timing in understanding.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to flowing form; discipline develops the fool — pleasure recognizes natural timing.

2.name: Gate 4 Line 2 - Developing at flowing form; bearing with fools kindly — acceptance tolerates varying understanding.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Current — building capacity in flowing form. "Bear with fools in kindliness, know how to take women, son takes charge" = at +2 development, tolerance and wisdom enable leadership. Development at Current requires accepting different capacities. At Current development, acceptance recognizes that not everyone can understand.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at flowing form; bearing with fools kindly — acceptance tolerates varying understanding.

3.name: Gate 4 Line 3 - Peak Current before transition; losing self to strength fails — irresponsibility enjoys formulas abstractly.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Current — peak flowing form before transition to inductance. "Maiden loses herself seeing bronze man, nothing furthers" = at pre-transition, losing individuality by imitating strength fails. The movement to +3 requires maintaining integrity. At +2 completion, irresponsibility enjoys formulas without practical application.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Current before transition; losing self to strength fails — irresponsibility enjoys formulas abstractly.

4.name: Gate 4 Line 4 - Entry to building pressure; entangled folly humiliates — the liar illustrates through fantasy.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Inductance after transition. "Entangled folly, humiliation" = at +3 entry, getting stuck in confusion fails. Entry to building after Current must clear confusion. At Inductance entry, the liar illustrates formulas through fantasy.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to building pressure; entangled folly humiliates — the liar illustrates through fantasy.

5.name: Gate 4 Line 5 - Developing at building pressure; childlike folly fortunate — seduction succeeds through others' understanding.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Inductance — building capacity in building pressure. "Childlike folly, good fortune" = at +3 development, humble inexperience succeeds. Development at Inductance benefits from open learning. At Inductance development, seduction succeeds through others' understanding.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at building pressure; childlike folly fortunate — seduction succeeds through others' understanding.

6.name: Gate 4 Line 6 - Completion at building pressure; don't transgress in punishing — excess waits patiently for completion.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Inductance — the material journey complete. "Punishing folly, don't transgress, prevent transgression" = at +3 completion, discipline must not become abuse. Complete building requires measured correction. At Inductance completion, excess recognizes incomplete understanding and waits.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at building pressure; don't transgress in punishing — excess waits patiently for completion.

1.name: Gate 5 Line 1 - Entry to Source; patient waiting in the meadow far from flow.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Source — first contact with pure potential. "Waiting in the meadow" = at entry to -4, wait in the open. The meadow is distant from the stream (destination); patience begins at entry. At Source entry, the journey to Current hasn't begun. Abiding in what endures = persevering in potential.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to Source; patient waiting in the meadow far from flow.

2.name: Gate 5 Line 2 - Developing at Source; sand is closer to flow than meadow — progress through patience.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Source — building capacity in potential. "Waiting on the sand" = closer to the water than the meadow; development at -4 moves toward the crossing. "Some gossip" = minor criticism for waiting, but perseverance yields fortune. At Source development, the potential is building. Sand is nearer to current than meadow.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at Source; sand is closer to flow than meadow — progress through patience.

3.name: Gate 5 Line 3 - Peak Source before crossing; mud at water's edge — vulnerable but close.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Source — peak potential before crossing. "Mud" = right at the water's edge. "Arrival of enemy" = at threshold, vulnerability increases. Pre-crossing is dangerous. At -4 completion, the crossing to Current is imminent. The mud shows maximum closeness to flow before actually crossing.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Source before crossing; mud at water's edge — vulnerable but close.

4.name: Gate 5 Line 4 - Entry to Current is dangerous; the hunter emerges from waiting.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Current after crossing. "Waiting in blood" = entry to flow is dangerous. "Get out of the pit" = immediate action required upon arriving at +2. The crossing has occurred; now survival is the concern. At Current entry, the transformation from potential to flow creates danger. The hunter must act.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to Current is dangerous; the hunter emerges from waiting.

5.name: Gate 5 Line 5 - Development at Current brings nourishment; joy in the flow.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Current — building capacity in flow. "Meat and drink" = nourishment at +2. The flow provides. Development at Current is about receiving what the flow offers. At Current development, the danger of entry has passed. Joy emerges from being in flow.
5.desc: Keynote: Development at Current brings nourishment; joy in the flow.

6.name: Gate 5 Line 6 - Completion at Current; yield to what flow brings — honor the unexpected.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Current — the journey from Source to Current is complete. "Falls into pit" = completion at +2 is submersion in flow. "Three uninvited guests" = unexpected elements at completion. "Honor them" = accept what flow brings. At Current completion, the flow is fully entered. Yielding to what arrives, even unexpected, brings fortune.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at Current; yield to what flow brings — honor the unexpected.

1.name: Gate 6 Line 1 - Entry to flow oriented toward return; don't perpetuate — retreat is wisdom.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Current — first contact with flow in a dematerialising gate. "Not perpetuating the affair" = at +2 entry, don't escalate. The journey back to Source requires not engaging the conflict fully. At Current entry for dematerialisation, the wisest path is minimal engagement.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to flow oriented toward return; don't perpetuate — retreat is wisdom.

2.name: Gate 6 Line 2 - Developing at Current; tactical withdrawal protects community — don't engage fully.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Current preparing for dematerialisation. "Cannot engage in conflict" = development at +2 for return means not fighting. "Returns home" = development toward Source. The community benefits from not engaging. At Current development for dematerialisation, tactical withdrawal serves everyone.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at Current; tactical withdrawal protects community — don't engage fully.

3.name: Gate 6 Line 3 - Peak Current before Source-return; allegiance and ancient virtue enable the dangerous crossing.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Current — peak flow before the crossing to Source. "Ancient virtue" = pre-crossing draws on accumulated wisdom. "Danger but good end" = threshold is perilous but successful crossing occurs. "Seek not works" = don't initiate new projects at threshold. At +2 completion, the return to Source is imminent. Allegiance to something beyond the conflict enables the crossing.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Current before Source-return; allegiance and ancient virtue enable the dangerous crossing.

4.name: Gate 6 Line 4 - Entry to Source resolves conflict; submit to fate, find peace.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Source after crossing. "Cannot engage" (repeated from Line 2) = entry to Source means conflict is over. "Submits to fate" = acceptance at -4. "Finds peace in perseverance" = entry to Source IS peace after conflict. At Source entry, the dematerialisation has occurred. The conflicted journey from flow resolves in potential.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to Source resolves conflict; submit to fate, find peace.

5.name: Gate 6 Line 5 - Development at Source is arbitration; submit conflict to higher authority.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Source — building capacity in potential. "Contend before him" = at -4 development, bring the conflict to a higher authority (Source itself). Development at Source means submitting the conflict to creative potential for resolution. At Source development, arbitration replaces direct conflict.
5.desc: Keynote: Development at Source is arbitration; submit conflict to higher authority.

6.name: Gate 6 Line 6 - Source completion requires releasing conflict; victory through conflict doesn't last.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Source — the dematerialising journey complete. "Leather belt bestowed then snatched" = victory through conflict at Source completion doesn't last. What's won through conflict is taken away. At -4 completion, the conflict that drove the journey cannot produce lasting results. True peace requires releasing the conflict itself.
6.desc: Keynote: Source completion requires releasing conflict; victory through conflict doesn't last.

1.name: Gate 7 Line 1 - Entry to flowing form; proper order essential — the authoritarian guides with natural authority.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Current — first contact with flowing form in a material circulator. "Army sets forth in proper order" = at +2 entry, organization is essential from the start. Entry to flow requires immediate structure. At Current entry, the authoritarian guides with natural authority.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to flowing form; proper order essential — the authoritarian guides with natural authority.

2.name: Gate 7 Line 2 - Developing at flowing form; in the midst of the army — the democrat leads when chosen.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Current — building capacity in flowing form. "In midst of army, good fortune, triple decoration" = at +2 development, central command succeeds. Development at Current places the leader in the middle. At Current development, the democrat leads when chosen.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at flowing form; in the midst of the army — the democrat leads when chosen.

3.name: Gate 7 Line 3 - Peak Current before transition; corpses in wagon — the anarchist expresses many roles.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Current — peak flowing form before transition to sink. "Army carries corpses" = at pre-transition, usurped authority brings disaster. The movement to +4 requires legitimate command. At +2 completion, the anarchist expresses many roles but risks denying all value.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Current before transition; corpses in wagon — the anarchist expresses many roles.

4.name: Gate 7 Line 4 - Entry to full manifestation; retreat without blame — the abdicator accepts judgment.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Sink after transition. "Army retreats, no blame" = at +4 entry, strategic withdrawal is appropriate. Entry to full manifestation after Current can mean stepping back. At Sink entry, the abdicator accepts others' judgment.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to full manifestation; retreat without blame — the abdicator accepts judgment.

5.name: Gate 7 Line 5 - Developing at full manifestation; let the eldest lead — the general attracts loyalty.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Sink — building capacity in full manifestation. "Game in field, let eldest lead" = at +4 development, proper hierarchy succeeds. Development at Sink requires experienced leadership. At Sink development, the general attracts loyalty through role.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at full manifestation; let the eldest lead — the general attracts loyalty.

6.name: Gate 7 Line 6 - Completion at full manifestation; prince founds states — the administrator communicates responsibility.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Sink — the material journey complete. "Prince issues commands, founds states, vests families" = at +4 completion, the victory is administered. Complete manifestation establishes lasting order. At Sink completion, the administrator communicates responsibility.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at full manifestation; prince founds states — the administrator communicates responsibility.

1.name: Gate 8 Line 1 - Entry to full manifestation; truth like a full bowl — honesty shares creative expression.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Sink — first contact with full manifestation in a material circulator moving toward current. "Hold in truth and loyalty, full bowl, fortune from without" = at +4 entry, sincerity attracts external support. Entry to complete form requires authentic foundation. At Sink entry, honesty communicates creative expression.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to full manifestation; truth like a full bowl — honesty shares creative expression.

2.name: Gate 8 Line 2 - Developing at full manifestation; hold inwardly — service as unselfish example.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Sink — building capacity in full manifestation. "Hold to him inwardly, perseverance fortunate" = at +4 development, inner connection sustains. Development at Sink requires internal dedication. At Sink development, service becomes an example through unselfish expression.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at full manifestation; hold inwardly — service as unselfish example.

3.name: Gate 8 Line 3 - Peak Sink before transition; holding with wrong people — the phoney expresses style not substance.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Sink — peak full manifestation before transition to current. "Holding with wrong people" = at pre-transition, false connections must be released. The movement to +2 requires authentic bonds. At +4 completion, the phoney expresses through style not substance.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Sink before transition; holding with wrong people — the phoney expresses style not substance.

4.name: Gate 8 Line 4 - Entry to flowing form; hold outwardly also — respect contributes as example.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Current after transition. "Hold outwardly also, perseverance fortunate" = at +2 entry, external connection now matches internal. Entry to flow after Sink unifies inner and outer. At Current entry, respect drives contribution as example.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to flowing form; hold outwardly also — respect contributes as example.

5.name: Gate 8 Line 5 - Developing at flowing form; three-sided hunt — dharma contributes accepting limitation.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Current — building capacity in flowing form. "King uses three-sided hunt, foregoes escaping game" = at +2 development, unity is not forced. Development at Current allows freedom within connection. At Current development, dharma contributes through sharing that accepts limitation.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at flowing form; three-sided hunt — dharma contributes accepting limitation.

6.name: Gate 8 Line 6 - Completion at flowing form; no head brings misfortune — communion knows when to contribute.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Current — the material journey complete. "No head for holding together, misfortune" = at +2 completion, unity without proper leadership fails. Complete flow requires appropriate guidance. At Current completion, communion knows when to contribute.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at flowing form; no head brings misfortune — communion knows when to contribute.

1.name: Gate 9 Line 1 - Entry to pure potential; return to the way — sensibility focuses to create new forms.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Source — first contact with pure potential in a void circulator. "Return to the way, no blame, good fortune" = at -4 entry, returning to fundamental nature succeeds. Entry to pure potential finds the way. At Source entry, sensibility focuses to create new forms.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to pure potential; return to the way — sensibility focuses to create new forms.

2.name: Gate 9 Line 2 - Developing at pure potential; drawn into returning together — misery loves company in focusing.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Source — building capacity in pure potential. "Allows himself to be drawn into returning, good fortune" = at -4 development, being drawn together with others succeeds. Development at Source involves collaborative return. At Source development, misery loves company — collaboration in focusing.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at pure potential; drawn into returning together — misery loves company in focusing.

3.name: Gate 9 Line 3 - Peak Source before transition; spokes burst, eyes roll — failure to focus loses power.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Source — peak pure potential before transition to resistance. "Spokes burst, man and wife roll eyes" = at pre-transition, tension reaches breaking point. The movement to -1 threatens to collapse. At -4 completion, the straw that breaks the camel's back — failure to focus loses power.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Source before transition; spokes burst, eyes roll — failure to focus loses power.

4.name: Gate 9 Line 4 - Entry to threshold pressure; sincerity dissolves blood and fear — dedication acts on focus.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Resistance after transition. "Sincere, blood vanishes, fear gives way, no blame" = at -1 entry, sincerity dissolves conflict and fear. Entry to threshold after Source finds peace through authenticity. At Resistance entry, dedication acts on the potential of focus.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to threshold pressure; sincerity dissolves blood and fear — dedication acts on focus.

5.name: Gate 9 Line 5 - Developing at threshold; sincere loyalty, rich in neighbor — faith brings value through concentration.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Resistance — building capacity at threshold pressure. "Sincere and loyal, rich in neighbor" = at -1 development, authentic connection brings shared wealth. Development at Resistance finds abundance through relationship. At Resistance development, faith focuses and brings value.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at threshold; sincere loyalty, rich in neighbor — faith brings value through concentration.

6.name: Gate 9 Line 6 - Completion at threshold; rain comes, rest — gratitude enjoys the concentrating process.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Resistance — the void journey complete. "Rain comes, rest; character's effect; woman in danger; moon nearly full; persistence brings misfortune" = at -1 completion, the taming has gathered clouds that finally rain. But continuing beyond this point brings danger. At Resistance completion, gratitude enjoys the concentrating process.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at threshold; rain comes, rest — gratitude enjoys the concentrating process.

1.name: Gate 10 Line 1 - Entry to void storage; simple conduct, progress — modesty knows one's place.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Capacitance — first contact with void storage in a void circulator. "Simple conduct, progress without blame" = at -3 entry, straightforward behavior succeeds. Entry to storage requires unpretentious approach. At Capacitance entry, modesty knows one's place despite circumstances.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to void storage; simple conduct, progress — modesty knows one's place.

2.name: Gate 10 Line 2 - Developing at void storage; smooth level course — the hermit maintains independence through isolation.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Capacitance — building capacity in void storage. "Smooth, level course; dark man's perseverance fortunate" = at -3 development, steady, withdrawn progress succeeds. Development at Capacitance requires solitary persistence. At Capacitance development, the hermit maintains independence through isolation.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at void storage; smooth level course — the hermit maintains independence through isolation.

3.name: Gate 10 Line 3 - Peak Capacitance before transition; one-eyed treads tiger's tail — the martyr is challenged.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Capacitance — peak void storage before transition to source. "One-eyed, lame, treads tiger's tail, bitten, warrior acts for prince" = at pre-transition, approach with limitations brings danger. The movement to -4 requires accepting consequences. At -3 completion, the martyr's behavior is challenged.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Capacitance before transition; one-eyed treads tiger's tail — the martyr is challenged.

4.name: Gate 10 Line 4 - Entry to pure potential; caution on tiger's tail — the opportunist waits for right moment.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Source after transition. "Treads tiger's tail, caution and circumspection lead to fortune" = at -4 entry, careful approach to pure potential succeeds. Entry to Source after Capacitance requires vigilant behavior. At Source entry, the opportunist waits for the right transformation moment.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to pure potential; caution on tiger's tail — the opportunist waits for right moment.

5.name: Gate 10 Line 5 - Developing at pure potential; resolute, aware of danger — the heretic challenges tradition.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Source — building capacity in pure potential. "Resolute conduct, persevere aware of danger" = at -4 development, determined behavior with eyes open succeeds. Development at Source requires principled action despite risk. At Source development, the heretic challenges tradition with principle.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at pure potential; resolute, aware of danger — the heretic challenges tradition.

6.name: Gate 10 Line 6 - Completion at pure potential; everything fulfilled — the role model expresses Self through action.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Source — the void journey complete. "Look to conduct, weigh signs, everything fulfilled, supreme fortune" = at -4 completion, examining behavior and recognizing completion brings highest success. Complete arrival at Source reviews and fulfills. At Source completion, the role model expresses Self through action.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at pure potential; everything fulfilled — the role model expresses Self through action.

1.name: Gate 11 Line 1 - First contact with the field of connected potentials.
1.asc: Line 1 of a cross-zero manifesting gate is first contact with the origin domain. Here, the origin is Heaven (-4) — the Source pole of maximum potential. The ribbon grass image is precise: when you pull at Source, connected potentials come with it. Ideas at the Source pole are not isolated — they exist in networks of related possibilities. "Each according to his kind" reflects the principle that potentials cluster by resonance.
1.desc: Keynote: First contact with the field of connected potentials.

2.name: Gate 11 Line 2 - Expanding the scope of potential before the great crossing.
2.asc: Line 2 in a cross-zero gate is development within the origin domain — building capacity before the threshold crossing. At position -4 (Source), this means developing the *range* and *tolerance* of what potential can hold. The I-Ching text emphasises expansion of scope: bearing with the uncultured (including what doesn't yet fit), fording the river (taking risks), not neglecting the distant (reaching beyond the immediate). This is preparation for the massive journey from -4 to +4.
2.desc: Keynote: Expanding the scope of potential before the great crossing.

3.name: Gate 11 Line 3 - The peak of potential, accepting the inevitability of manifestation.
3.asc: Line 3 is the completion of the inner trigram — the peak of the origin domain before the threshold crossing. In Gate 11, this is maximum development at Source (-4), the moment before the zero-crossing begins. The I-Ching text is profound here: *"No plain not followed by a slope"* — you cannot stay at Source. The crossing is coming. This line acknowledges that potential MUST become form; holding at -4 indefinitely is impossible.
3.desc: Keynote: The peak of potential, accepting the inevitability of manifestation.

4.name: Gate 11 Line 4 - First contact with manifest form; humble arrival at the Sink.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to the outer trigram — first contact with the destination domain after the zero-crossing. In Gate 11, this is arrival at Earth (+4), the Sink pole of maximum manifestation. The "fluttering down" image is perfect: after crossing zero, energy descends into form. "Not boasting of wealth" — the manifested idea doesn't announce itself; it simply arrives in form. "Together with his neighbor" — manifestation is relational; form exists among other forms.
4.desc: Keynote: First contact with manifest form; humble arrival at the Sink.

5.name: Gate 11 Line 5 - Developing form through relational distribution.
5.asc: Line 5 is development within the outer trigram — building capacity in the destination domain. At position +4 (Sink), this means developing the *relationships* and *distribution* of manifest form. The marriage image is striking: development at Sink involves giving form away to create unions. The sovereign gives his daughter — the highest value descends further into relationship. This is form propagating, not accumulating.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing form through relational distribution.

6.name: Gate 11 Line 6 - Full manifestation recognizing its own transience.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion of the outer trigram — full arrival at destination, gate completion. In Gate 11, this is maximum manifestation at Earth (+4), the end of the full-amplitude journey from Source to Sink. But the I-Ching warns: "The wall falls back into the moat." At maximum form (+4), dissolution begins. Form cannot hold indefinitely. The journey that began at -4 and arrived at +4 has created form that will eventually return to potential.
6.desc: Keynote: Full manifestation recognizing its own transience.

1.name: Gate 12 Line 1 - First contact with form, recognising what must be released.
1.asc: Line 1 of a cross-zero dematerialising gate is first contact with the origin domain — here, Earth (+4), maximum form. The journey toward Source begins by recognising what one is withdrawing FROM. The ribbon grass image (identical to Gate 11.1) takes opposite meaning here: interconnected FORMS, not potentials. Withdrawing from Sink means recognising that forms are connected — you cannot dematerialise one thing without affecting related structures.
1.desc: Keynote: First contact with form, recognising what must be released.

2.name: Gate 12 Line 2 - Purifying form in preparation for release.
2.asc: Line 2 is development within the origin domain — building capacity for the great crossing. At Sink (+4), this means purifying form, releasing attachments, preparing for dematerialisation. "Bearing and enduring" describes the discipline required: form must be held while being purified. The Sink position is dense — development here means reducing density, not adding to it.
2.desc: Keynote: Purifying form in preparation for release.

3.name: Gate 12 Line 3 - Confessing/releasing the last attachments to form before the crossing.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion of the inner trigram — peak of origin before threshold crossing. At Sink (+4), this is maximum density before dematerialisation. What remains must be confessed/released. "Concealed shame" = density that cannot cross zero. The pre-threshold moment requires confronting what in form is not ready to dematerialise. Confession is the release mechanism.
3.desc: Keynote: Confessing/releasing the last attachments to form before the crossing.

4.name: Gate 12 Line 4 - First contact with Source; receiving prophetic vision after dematerialisation.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to the outer trigram — first contact with Source after the zero-crossing. Having dematerialised from Sink, energy arrives at pure potential (-4). "Acting at the command of the highest" = aligned with Source. After crossing zero from form, the first contact with potential must be oriented by Source itself, not by residual form-attachments.
4.desc: Keynote: First contact with Source; receiving prophetic vision after dematerialisation.

5.name: Gate 12 Line 5 - Developing and anchoring what was gained through dematerialisation.
5.asc: Line 5 is development within the outer trigram — building capacity at Source. Having arrived at -4, potential must be cultivated, not rushed back into form. "Standstill is giving way" = dematerialisation completing. "What if it should fail?" reflects the vigilance needed at Source — potential is fragile. The mulberry shoots (multiple anchors) secure what has been achieved.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing and anchoring what was gained through dematerialisation.

6.name: Gate 12 Line 6 - Full arrival at Source; metamorphosis complete, ready for new manifestation.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion of the outer trigram — full arrival at Source (-4). The dematerialising journey is complete. From here, a new manifesting cycle can begin. "Standstill comes to an end" = dematerialisation complete. The gate has traversed the full wave from Sink to Source. At completion, potential is ready for new manifestation — the cycle turns.
6.desc: Keynote: Full arrival at Source; metamorphosis complete, ready for new manifestation.

1.name: Gate 13 Line 1 - Entry to illuminating pressure; fellowship at the gate — empathy listens with affection.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Voltage — first contact with illuminating pressure in a void circulator. "Fellowship at the gate, no blame" = at -2 entry, gathering at the threshold is blameless. Entry to illumination begins at the gate of fellowship. At Voltage entry, empathy listens with affection.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to illuminating pressure; fellowship at the gate — empathy listens with affection.

2.name: Gate 13 Line 2 - Developing at illuminating pressure; fellowship beyond clan — bigotry overcome through tolerance.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Voltage — building capacity in illuminating pressure. "Fellowship in the clan, humiliation" = at -2 development, limiting fellowship to clan brings shame. Development at Voltage must expand beyond narrow group. At Voltage development, bigotry is overcome through tolerance.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at illuminating pressure; fellowship beyond clan — bigotry overcome through tolerance.

3.name: Gate 13 Line 3 - Peak Voltage before transition; weapons hidden, long delay — pessimism seeks evidence.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Voltage — peak illuminating pressure before transition to source. "Weapons hidden, climbs hill, three years doesn't rise" = at pre-transition, conflict forces hiding and waiting. The movement to -4 is blocked. At -2 completion, pessimism seeks evidence through suspicious openness.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Voltage before transition; weapons hidden, long delay — pessimism seeks evidence.

4.name: Gate 13 Line 4 - Entry to pure potential; on wall, cannot attack — fatigue needs silence after openness.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Source after transition. "Climbs wall, cannot attack, good fortune" = at -4 entry, one is protected by height but cannot act. Entry to Source after Voltage finds rest rather than action. At Source entry, fatigue requires silence after openness.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to pure potential; on wall, cannot attack — fatigue needs silence after openness.

5.name: Gate 13 Line 5 - Developing at pure potential; weep then laugh — the saviour finds roles for others.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Source — building capacity in pure potential. "First weep and lament, then laugh; after struggle they meet" = at -4 development, fellowship comes through suffering before joy. Development at Source involves grief before reunion. At Source development, the saviour finds roles for others.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at pure potential; weep then laugh — the saviour finds roles for others.

6.name: Gate 13 Line 6 - Completion at pure potential; fellowship in the meadow — the optimist hopes for better relationships.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Source — the void journey complete. "Fellowship in the meadow, no remorse" = at -4 completion, gathering in open ground succeeds. Complete arrival at Source finds fellowship in wide open space. At Source completion, the optimist hopes openness leads to better relationships.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at pure potential; fellowship in the meadow — the optimist hopes for better relationships.

1.name: Gate 14 Line 1 - Entry to pure potential; avoid harm, stay aware — money isn't everything, higher principles key.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Source — first contact with pure potential in a void circulator. "No relationship with harmful, conscious of difficulty, no blame" = at -4 entry, avoiding harm and remaining aware protects. Entry to source requires discrimination. At Source entry, money isn't everything — higher principles manifest power.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to pure potential; avoid harm, stay aware — money isn't everything, higher principles key.

2.name: Gate 14 Line 2 - Developing at pure potential; big wagon ready — management shares the work.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Source — building capacity in pure potential. "Big wagon for loading, may undertake, no blame" = at -4 development, having capacity enables undertaking. Development at Source builds transportation for wealth. At Source development, management recognizes one cannot do everything alone.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at pure potential; big wagon ready — management shares the work.

3.name: Gate 14 Line 3 - Peak Source before transition; prince offers to heaven — service contributes selflessly.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Source — peak pure potential before transition to voltage. "Prince offers to Son of Heaven, petty man cannot" = at pre-transition, great wealth must be offered upward. The movement to -2 requires generosity of spirit. At -4 completion, service contributes selflessly.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Source before transition; prince offers to heaven — service contributes selflessly.

4.name: Gate 14 Line 4 - Entry to illuminating pressure; distinguish yourself — security develops foundational skills.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Voltage after transition. "Makes difference between self and neighbor, no blame" = at -2 entry, distinguishing oneself is appropriate. Entry to illumination after Source establishes distinction. At Voltage entry, security develops skills for strong foundation.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to illuminating pressure; distinguish yourself — security develops foundational skills.

5.name: Gate 14 Line 5 - Developing at illuminating pressure; truth accessible yet dignified — arrogance as innate dignity.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Voltage — building capacity in illuminating pressure. "Truth accessible yet dignified, good fortune" = at -2 development, being both open and dignified succeeds. Development at Voltage requires accessible dignity. At Voltage development, arrogance recognizes innate dignity as key to power.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at illuminating pressure; truth accessible yet dignified — arrogance as innate dignity.

6.name: Gate 14 Line 6 - Completion at illuminating pressure; blessed by heaven — humility accepts spirituality as power source.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Voltage — the void journey complete. "Blessed by heaven, good fortune, nothing not furthered" = at -2 completion, heavenly blessing brings total success. Complete arrival at Voltage receives universal favor. At Voltage completion, humility recognizes spirituality as source of power.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at illuminating pressure; blessed by heaven — humility accepts spirituality as power source.

1.name: Gate 15 Line 1 - Entry to building pressure; modest about modesty — duty through harmonic relationships.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Inductance — first contact with building pressure in a material circulator. "Modest about modesty, may cross great water" = at +3 entry, humility about humility enables great undertakings. Entry to building requires unpretentious approach. At Inductance entry, duty confronts challenges through harmonic relationships.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to building pressure; modest about modesty — duty through harmonic relationships.

2.name: Gate 15 Line 2 - Developing at building pressure; modesty expressed — influence accepts its extreme nature.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Inductance — building capacity in building pressure. "Modesty that comes to expression, perseverance fortunate" = at +3 development, expressed humility brings success. Development at Inductance manifests its modest nature. At Inductance development, influence accepts extreme nature as correct.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at building pressure; modesty expressed — influence accepts its extreme nature.

3.name: Gate 15 Line 3 - Peak Inductance before transition; merit carries through — ego inflation as strategic control.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Inductance — peak building pressure before transition to sink. "Superior man of merit carries to conclusion" = at pre-transition, achievement through effort succeeds. The movement to +4 requires completion of building work. At +3 completion, ego inflation uses extremism to control flow.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Inductance before transition; merit carries through — ego inflation as strategic control.

4.name: Gate 15 Line 4 - Entry to full manifestation; modesty in all movement — the wallflower uncomfortable when out of flow.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Sink after transition. "Nothing that would not further modesty in movement" = at +4 entry, all actions benefit from humility. Entry to full manifestation after Inductance finds modesty always appropriate. At Sink entry, the wallflower is uncomfortable when out of flow.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to full manifestation; modesty in all movement — the wallflower uncomfortable when out of flow.

5.name: Gate 15 Line 5 - Developing at full manifestation; no boasting, forceful action — sensitivity grows through extremes.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Sink — building capacity in full manifestation. "No boasting of wealth, favorable to attack with force" = at +4 development, quiet strength succeeds. Development at Sink combines modesty with decisive action. At Sink development, sensitivity grows through experiencing extremes.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at full manifestation; no boasting, forceful action — sensitivity grows through extremes.

6.name: Gate 15 Line 6 - Completion at full manifestation; chastise own domain — self-defence finds the weakest point.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Sink — the material journey complete. "Modesty expressed, favorable to chastise own city and country" = at +4 completion, self-correction through expressed humility. Complete manifestation turns examination inward. At Sink completion, self-defence explores extremes to find weakest point.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at full manifestation; chastise own domain — self-defence finds the weakest point.

1.name: Gate 16 Line 1 - Entry to full manifestation; expressing too soon brings misfortune — delusion daydreams talent.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Sink — first contact with full manifestation in a material circulator moving toward threshold. "Enthusiasm expressing itself brings misfortune" = at +4 entry, premature expression fails. Entry to complete form must not release energy too soon. At Sink entry, delusion expresses talent through daydreaming.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to full manifestation; expressing too soon brings misfortune — delusion daydreams talent.

2.name: Gate 16 Line 2 - Developing at full manifestation; firm as rock, quick perception — the cynic judges objectively.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Sink — building capacity in full manifestation. "Firm as rock, not a whole day, perseverance fortunate" = at +4 development, groundedness with quick discernment succeeds. Development at Sink requires solid judgment without delay. At Sink development, the cynic judges objectively.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at full manifestation; firm as rock, quick perception — the cynic judges objectively.

3.name: Gate 16 Line 3 - Peak Sink before transition; neither yearning nor hesitating — independence expresses proper timing.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Sink — peak full manifestation before transition to threshold. "Looking upward creates remorse, hesitation creates remorse" = at pre-transition, both yearning and delay fail. The movement to +1 requires proper timing. At +4 completion, independence expresses proper timing and rhythm.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Sink before transition; neither yearning nor hesitating — independence expresses proper timing.

4.name: Gate 16 Line 4 - Entry to threshold; source of enthusiasm, gathers friends — the leader recognizes others' talents.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Gate-IN after transition. "Source of enthusiasm, achieves great things, gathers friends" = at +1 entry, energy from Sink becomes the source of new activity. Entry to threshold after complete form enables leadership. At Gate-IN entry, the leader recognizes and supports others' talents.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to threshold; source of enthusiasm, gathers friends — the leader recognizes others' talents.

5.name: Gate 16 Line 5 - Developing at threshold; persistently ill yet not dying — the grinch needs encouragement.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Gate-IN — building capacity at entry threshold. "Persistently ill, still does not die" = at +1 development, there is chronic weakness but survival. Development at Gate-IN struggles but persists. At Gate-IN development, the grinch lacks confidence in skill expression.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at threshold; persistently ill yet not dying — the grinch needs encouragement.

6.name: Gate 16 Line 6 - Completion at threshold; deluded but can change — gullibility must assess others' expression.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Gate-IN — the material journey complete. "Deluded enthusiasm, but change after completion, no blame" = at +1 completion, the enthusiasm was based on illusion, yet correction possible. Complete arrival at threshold can recognize and correct delusion. At Gate-IN completion, gullibility needs talent to assess others' expression.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at threshold; deluded but can change — gullibility must assess others' expression.

1.name: Gate 17 Line 1 - Entry to initiation threshold; the standard changes — openness to many opinions.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Gate-IN — first contact with the initiation threshold in a dematerialising gate. "The standard is changing" = at +1 entry, the rules of engagement shift. "Going out the door in company" = entry to Gate-IN for dematerialisation requires openness to others' views. At Gate-IN entry for dematerialisation, many opinions are possible because the standard itself is changing.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to initiation threshold; the standard changes — openness to many opinions.

2.name: Gate 17 Line 2 - Developing at entry threshold; choose wisely — discrimination between weak and strong.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Gate-IN — building capacity at the entry threshold. "Clings to little boy, loses strong man" = at +1 development, choice of what to follow matters. Development at Gate-IN for dematerialisation requires discrimination about allegiances. At Gate-IN development, discriminating between weak and strong relationships shapes the following.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at entry threshold; choose wisely — discrimination between weak and strong.

3.name: Gate 17 Line 3 - Peak Gate-IN before crossing; through following find what you seek — understanding grounded in detail.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Gate-IN — peak entry threshold before crossing. "Clings to strong man, loses little boy" = at pre-threshold, commitment to substance releases triviality. "Through following one finds" = accepting the crossing to Capacitance brings what is sought. At +1 completion, understanding through detail prepares for the dematerialisation.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Gate-IN before crossing; through following find what you seek — understanding grounded in detail.

4.name: Gate 17 Line 4 - Entry to stored joy; following succeeds but persistence fails — go your way with sincerity.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Capacitance after crossing. "Following creates success, but perseverance brings misfortune" = at -3 entry, the dematerialisation is complete but rigid continuation fails. "Go one's way with sincerity" = entry to stored joy requires authentic personal path. At Capacitance entry, opinions must be based on understanding others, not merely attracting them.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to stored joy; following succeeds but persistence fails — go your way with sincerity.

5.name: Gate 17 Line 5 - Developing at stored joy; sincere in the good — no one is an island.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Capacitance — building capacity in stored joy. "Sincere in the good" = at -3 development, authentic positive intention succeeds. Development at Capacitance means recognizing interdependence. At Capacitance development, no one is isolated — opinions must express the value of organization.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at stored joy; sincere in the good — no one is an island.

6.name: Gate 17 Line 6 - Completion at stored joy; firm allegiance to the sacred — the Bodhisattva serves all.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Capacitance — the dematerialising journey complete. "Firm allegiance, further bound, king introduces to Western Mountain" = at -3 completion, the following has reached sacred commitment. The Western Mountain represents spiritual culmination. At Capacitance completion, the Bodhisattva understands interdependency so deeply that opinions serve all beings.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at stored joy; firm allegiance to the sacred — the Bodhisattva serves all.

1.name: Gate 18 Line 1 - Entry to release threshold; setting right the father's spoiling — conservatism corrects gradually.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Gate-OUT — first contact with release threshold in a manifesting gate. "Setting right father's spoiling, son takes responsibility, danger but fortune" = at -1 entry, one inherits the patterns requiring correction. Entry to release for manifestation begins by accepting responsibility for what was spoiled. At Gate-OUT entry for manifestation, conservatism corrects gradually through modified judgments.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to release threshold; setting right the father's spoiling — conservatism corrects gradually.

2.name: Gate 18 Line 2 - Developing at release threshold; mother's spoiling requires gentleness — terminal disease accepts what cannot be corrected.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Gate-OUT — building capacity in release threshold. "Mother's spoiling, not too persevering" = at -1 development, the decay is softer (mother vs. father) but requires gentle handling. Development at Gate-OUT must recognize what CAN be corrected versus what cannot. At Gate-OUT development, terminal disease accepts when correction is impossible.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at release threshold; mother's spoiling requires gentleness — terminal disease accepts what cannot be corrected.

3.name: Gate 18 Line 3 - Peak Gate-OUT before crossing; energetic correction of father's decay — the zealot obsesses on critical potential.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Gate-OUT — peak release threshold before crossing. "Father's spoiling, little remorse, no great blame" = at pre-threshold, energetic correction proceeds. The crossing to +3 requires determined effort. At -1 completion, the zealot becomes obsessed with correction as critical potential.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Gate-OUT before crossing; energetic correction of father's decay — the zealot obsesses on critical potential.

4.name: Gate 18 Line 4 - Entry to building pressure; tolerance brings humiliation — incompetence generates suffering.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Inductance after crossing. "Tolerating father's spoiling, continuing sees humiliation" = at +3 entry, mere tolerance without correction fails. Entry to building pressure after crossing Gate-OUT requires active work, not passive acceptance. At Inductance entry, incompetence — the inability to correct — generates suffering.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to building pressure; tolerance brings humiliation — incompetence generates suffering.

5.name: Gate 18 Line 5 - Developing at building pressure; setting right meets praise — therapy corrects through relationship.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Inductance — building capacity in building pressure. "Setting right, meeting praise" = at +3 development, proper correction succeeds. Development at Inductance brings recognition through effective correction. At Inductance development, therapy corrects through relational judgment.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at building pressure; setting right meets praise — therapy corrects through relationship.

6.name: Gate 18 Line 6 - Completion at building pressure; higher goals than serving — Buddhahood achieves perfected form.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Inductance — the manifesting journey complete. "Not serving kings, higher goals" = at +3 completion, correction transcends worldly structures. Complete manifestation at Inductance achieves self-perfection. At Inductance completion, Buddhahood achieves perfected form through correction.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at building pressure; higher goals than serving — Buddhahood achieves perfected form.

1.name: Gate 19 Line 1 - Entry to stored potential together; interdependence — maintain individual character.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Capacitance — first contact with stored potential. "Advancing in company" = at -3 entry, approach happens with others. Entry to stored potential for manifestation is shared, interdependent. At Capacitance entry for manifestation, individual character must be maintained while approaching together.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to stored potential together; interdependence — maintain individual character.

2.name: Gate 19 Line 2 - Developing stored potential through service; advancing together is advantageous.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Capacitance — building capacity in stored potential. "Advancing together, advantageous in every way" = at -3 development, mutual approach builds power. Development at Capacitance for manifestation multiplies through service. At Capacitance development, dedication to highest values builds the charge.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing stored potential through service; advancing together is advantageous.

3.name: Gate 19 Line 3 - Peak Capacitance before crossing; pleasure alone brings no advantage — dedication maintains communion.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Capacitance — peak stored potential before crossing. "Well pleased but no advantage" = at pre-threshold, enthusiasm without strategic value. Becoming anxious = recognizing the threshold requires care. At -3 completion, the crossing to +4 requires dedicated communion, not just pleasure.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Capacitance before crossing; pleasure alone brings no advantage — dedication maintains communion.

4.name: Gate 19 Line 4 - Entry to full manifestation; highest mode achieved — drive the team forward.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Sink after crossing. "Advancing in highest mode, no error" = at +4 entry, the manifestation is correct. Entry to full form after crossing Capacitance is achieved properly. At Sink entry, the approach succeeds through team effort.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to full manifestation; highest mode achieved — drive the team forward.

5.name: Gate 19 Line 5 - Developing at full manifestation; wisdom through sacrifice — practice self-restraint.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Sink — building capacity at full manifestation. "Advance of wisdom befitting great ruler" = at +4 development, wisdom guides the form. Development at Sink requires the sacrifice of restraint. At Sink development, wisdom develops through self-restraint.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at full manifestation; wisdom through sacrifice — practice self-restraint.

6.name: Gate 19 Line 6 - Completion at full manifestation; honest generosity — the sage on the hill.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Sink — the manifesting journey complete. "Honesty and generosity bring fortune" = at +4 completion, authentic giving completes the approach. But Ra's "Recluse" suggests completion at full form can mean withdrawal. At Sink completion, the approach has fully manifested — generosity flows, yet the sage retreats.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at full manifestation; honest generosity — the sage on the hill.

1.name: Gate 20 Line 1 - Entry to full form; child's looking — superficiality acceptable at entry but won't go far.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Sink — first contact with full form in a dematerialising gate. "Child's looking" = at +4 entry, perception is immature. Entry to complete form before dematerialisation is naturally superficial. At Sink entry for dematerialisation, childlike observation is acceptable — but limited.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to full form; child's looking — superficiality acceptable at entry but won't go far.

2.name: Gate 20 Line 2 - Developing at full form; peeping through the door — narrow view can serve, or mislead.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Sink — building capacity in full form. "Through crack of door" = at +4 development, vision is restricted. Development at Sink for dematerialisation maintains narrow focus — like a woman's domestic sphere (in classical terms). At Sink development, limited perspective can be appropriate — but risks dogmatism.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at full form; peeping through the door — narrow view can serve, or mislead.

3.name: Gate 20 Line 3 - Peak Sink before crossing; contemplating my life — self-awareness decides direction.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Sink — peak form before crossing. "My life decides advance or retreat" = at pre-threshold, self-examination determines direction. The crossing to -1 requires knowing whether to proceed. At +4 completion, self-awareness determines the dematerialisation direction.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Sink before crossing; contemplating my life — self-awareness decides direction.

4.name: Gate 20 Line 4 - Entry to penetrating perception; guest of the king — apply contemplation to serve.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Gate-OUT after crossing. "Glory of the kingdom, guest of king" = at -1 entry, perception serves leadership. Entry to penetrating vision after dematerialisation enables influence. At Gate-OUT entry, the contemplation becomes applicable.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to penetrating perception; guest of the king — apply contemplation to serve.

5.name: Gate 20 Line 5 - Developing at penetrating perception; realistic self-examination — concentration perfects.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Gate-OUT — building capacity in penetrating perception. "My life, without blame" = at -1 development, examining one's own impact is blameless. Development at perception means realistic self-examination. At Gate-OUT development, realism perfects the contemplation.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at penetrating perception; realistic self-examination — concentration perfects.

6.name: Gate 20 Line 6 - Completion at penetrating perception; wisdom sees universal principles — for society's benefit.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Gate-OUT — the dematerialising journey complete. "His life" (not "my life") = at -1 completion, perception has transcended personal focus. The contemplation now sees universal patterns. At Gate-OUT completion, wisdom perceives principles rather than just self.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at penetrating perception; wisdom sees universal principles — for society's benefit.

1.name: Gate 21 Line 1 - Entry to initiation threshold; feet in stocks — warning establishes respect.

"No blame" = the constraint at entry is acceptable. At Gate-IN entry for dematerialisation, warning establishes boundaries through will power.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to initiation threshold; feet in stocks — warning establishes respect.

2.name: Gate 21 Line 2 - Developing at entry threshold; biting deep — might legitimately rejects interference.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Gate-IN — building capacity at the entry threshold. "Bites tender meat, nose disappears" = at +1 development, easy targets are consumed with full immersion. Development at Gate-IN for dematerialisation means asserting might. At Gate-IN development, legitimate force rejects interference.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at entry threshold; biting deep — might legitimately rejects interference.

3.name: Gate 21 Line 3 - Peak Gate-IN before crossing; dried meat contains poison — powerlessness when off one's path.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Gate-IN — peak entry threshold before crossing. "Old dried meat, strikes poison, slight humiliation" = at pre-threshold, difficult obstacles contain hidden danger. The crossing to -2 brings encounter with toxicity. At +1 completion, powerlessness emerges when not following one's own path.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Gate-IN before crossing; dried meat contains poison — powerlessness when off one's path.

4.name: Gate 21 Line 4 - Entry to illuminating pressure; gristly meat yields arrows — strategy responds to conditions.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Voltage after crossing. "Dried gristly meat, metal arrows" = at -2 entry, tough obstacles yield valuable tools. "Mindful of difficulties, persevering" = entry to illuminating pressure requires strategic awareness. At Voltage entry, strategy applies will power in response to conditions.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to illuminating pressure; gristly meat yields arrows — strategy responds to conditions.

5.name: Gate 21 Line 5 - Developing at illuminating pressure; lean meat yields gold — objectivity balances will.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Voltage — building capacity in illuminating pressure. "Dried lean meat, yellow gold, aware of danger" = at -2 development, substantial effort yields precious reward. Development at Voltage requires objective will. At Voltage development, objectivity balances the ego's force.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at illuminating pressure; lean meat yields gold — objectivity balances will.

6.name: Gate 21 Line 6 - Completion at illuminating pressure; neck bound, ears lost — chaos when will loses touch.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Voltage — the dematerialising journey complete. "Neck in cangue, ears disappear, misfortune" = at -2 completion, the constraint reaches the head. The ears — receptivity — are lost. This is one of the rare explicitly negative completions. At Voltage completion, chaos emerges when touch is lost. Will power without connection creates disorder.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at illuminating pressure; neck bound, ears lost — chaos when will loses touch.

1.name: Gate 22 Line 1 - Entry to illuminating pressure; grace to the toes — enjoy the humble position.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Voltage — first contact with illuminating pressure in a manifesting gate. "Grace to toes, leaves carriage and walks" = at -2 entry, beauty begins at the lowest level. Choosing humility over status. At Voltage entry for manifestation, accepting a subordinate position with awareness brings grace.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to illuminating pressure; grace to the toes — enjoy the humble position.

2.name: Gate 22 Line 2 - Developing at illuminating pressure; grace to the beard — charm attracts through awareness.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Voltage — building capacity in illuminating pressure. "Grace to the beard" = at -2 development, beauty adorns what naturally grows. Development at Voltage means cultivating attractive style. At Voltage development, charm attracts through emotional awareness.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at illuminating pressure; grace to the beard — charm attracts through awareness.

At Capacitance development, restraint builds the charge for manifestation.

5.name: Gate 54 Line 5 - Developing at initiation; the princess's simplicity — magnanimity values substance over show.

At Gate-IN development, the nearly full moon suggests approaching but not yet complete manifestation.

6.name: Gate 54 Line 6 - Completion at initiation; empty basket, bloodless sacrifice — selectivity restricts what hinders.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Gate-IN — the manifesting journey complete. "Empty basket, bloodless sacrifice" = at +1 completion, the forms are present but substance is absent. Nothing furthers. At Gate-IN completion, the ambition has manifested but arrives empty. Selectivity about relationships becomes critical.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at initiation; empty basket, bloodless sacrifice — selectivity restricts what hinders.

2.name: Gate 55 Line 2 - Developing at illuminating pressure; stars seen at noon — truth penetrates distrust.

At -2 completion, innocence protects spirit despite injury and expectations.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Voltage before crossing; broken arm but blameless — innocence protects spirit.

4.name: Gate 55 Line 4 - Entry to initiation; meets the like ruler — assimilation balances energy and awareness.

Entry to initiation after crossing Voltage brings fortunate meeting. At Gate-IN entry, assimilation balances emotional energy and awareness.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to initiation; meets the like ruler — assimilation balances energy and awareness.

5.name: Gate 55 Line 5 - Developing at initiation; blessing and fame draw near — growth from positions of power.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Gate-IN — building capacity in entry initiation. "Lines coming, blessing and fame near, good fortune" = at +1 development, the abundance now draws positive forces. Development at Gate-IN attracts recognition. At Gate-IN development, growth brings emotional strength from positions of power.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at initiation; blessing and fame draw near — growth from positions of power.

6.name: Gate 55 Line 6 - Completion at initiation; screened house, blind three years — selfishness isolates into misfortune.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Gate-IN — the manifesting journey complete. "House in abundance, screens off family, peers through gate seeing no one, three years blind, misfortune" = at +1 completion, the abundance has become isolation. One of the rare explicitly negative completions. At Gate-IN completion, selfishness screens off connection. Abundance becomes prison.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at initiation; screened house, blind three years — selfishness isolates into misfortune.

2.name: Gate 56 Line 2 - Developing at building pressure; wanderer at inn with resources — linkage needs time to mature.

At Inductance development, linkage stimulates expression that needs time and recognition.

3.name: Gate 56 Line 3 - Peak Inductance before crossing; inn burns, servant lost — alienation controls the focus.

4.name: Gate 56 Line 4 - Entry to illuminating pressure; shelter with axe but heart not glad — expediency protects.

5.name: Gate 56 Line 5 - Developing at illuminating pressure; pheasant shot, praise won — attracting attention innovatively.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Voltage — building capacity in illuminating pressure.
