At Voltage development, attracting attention through innovative stimulation.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at illuminating pressure; pheasant shot, praise won — attracting attention innovatively.

6.name: Gate 56 Line 6 - Completion at illuminating pressure; nest burns, laughter turns to tears — caution lives by one's word.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Voltage — the dematerialising journey complete. "Nest burns, first laughs then weeps, loses cow through carelessness, misfortune" = at -2 completion, complete dematerialisation burns the last refuge. Carelessness now costs dearly. At Voltage completion, caution requires honesty and living by one's word.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at illuminating pressure; nest burns, laughter turns to tears — caution lives by one's word.

1.name: Gate 57 Line 1 - Entry to release threshold creates directional uncertainty; warrior perseverance required.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Gate-OUT — first contact with the release threshold. "Advancing and retreating" = at entry to -1, direction is uncertain. The warrior's perseverance navigates this. At Gate-OUT entry, the boundary between form and release creates initial confusion.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to release threshold creates directional uncertainty; warrior perseverance required.

2.name: Gate 57 Line 2 - Developing penetration to hidden places; cleansing at the release threshold.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Gate-OUT — building release capacity. "Penetration under the bed" = the gentle wind finds hidden places. "Priests and magicians" = specialists in the subtle. At -1 development, the release threshold develops capacity to find and dissolve hidden blockages.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing penetration to hidden places; cleansing at the release threshold.

3.name: Gate 57 Line 3 - Peak internal release; repeated penetration brings humiliation — know when to stop.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion of internal release — maximum internal Gate-OUT. "Repeated penetration" = over-doing at -1. Humiliation from persistence past the point of effectiveness. At Gate-OUT internal peak, the pressure for external expression builds. Over-penetration internally becomes problematic.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak internal release; repeated penetration brings humiliation — know when to stop.

4.name: Gate 57 Line 4 - External release entry resolves remorse; productive direction yields diverse results.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to external release — first expression of Gate-OUT outward. "Remorse vanishes" = entry to external expression resolves internal pressure. "Three kinds of game" = external release produces diverse results. External expression of Gate-OUT begins productively after internal completion.
4.desc: Keynote: External release entry resolves remorse; productive direction yields diverse results.

5.name: Gate 57 Line 5 - Developed external release focuses on endings; change is process, not event.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at external release — building capacity for sustained expression. "No beginning but an end" = development at -1 focuses on completion, not initiation. "Three days before and after" = timing around transition. At Gate-OUT development externally, the focus is on completing the release process.
5.desc: Keynote: Developed external release focuses on endings; change is process, not event.

6.name: Gate 57 Line 6 - Release completion loses resources; know when penetration has reached its limit.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion of the standing wave — maximum external expression at Gate-OUT. "Penetration under bed" (again, like Line 2) but now "loses property and ax" = completion at -1 loses tools and resources. Perseverance is now misfortune. At Gate-OUT completion, the release threshold has been fully expressed. Continuing to penetrate loses what was meant to be kept.
6.desc: Keynote: Release completion loses resources; know when penetration has reached its limit.

1.name: Gate 58 Line 1 - Entry to stored potential is contented; joy sufficient unto itself.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Capacitance — first contact with stored potential. "Contented joyousness" = entry to -3 is satisfied, self-sufficient. Good fortune from genuine connection with stored potential. At Capacitance entry, the stored potential is simply present — contented, not seeking.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to stored potential is contented; joy sufficient unto itself.

2.name: Gate 58 Line 2 - Developing sincere stored potential; authenticity builds joy capacity.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Capacitance — building joy capacity. "Sincere joyousness" = development at -3 means genuine, not forced. Remorse disappears when joy is authentically developed. At Capacitance development, the stored potential increases through sincerity.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing sincere stored potential; authenticity builds joy capacity.

3.name: Gate 58 Line 3 - Internal stored potential peaked; seeking external joy indicates depletion — wait or express.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion of internal joy — maximum internal stored potential. "Coming joyousness" = joy sought externally. "Misfortune" = at -3 internal completion, seeking joy from outside indicates the internal store is depleted. At Capacitance internal peak, the pressure for external expression builds. Seeking more internally is problematic.
3.desc: Keynote: Internal stored potential peaked; seeking external joy indicates depletion — wait or express.

4.name: Gate 58 Line 4 - External joy requires discernment; focused expression after clearing mistakes.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to external joy — first expression of stored potential outward. "Weighed joyousness not at peace" = entry to external expression requires discernment. "After ridding mistakes" = external joy follows internal completion of errors. External expression of Capacitance begins with focused, discerning joy.
4.desc: Keynote: External joy requires discernment; focused expression after clearing mistakes.

5.name: Gate 58 Line 5 - Developed external joy needs defense; sincerity to disintegrating influences is dangerous.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at external joy — building capacity for sustained expression. "Sincerity toward disintegrating influences" = development at -3 externally requires discrimination. Not all external influences deserve joy. At Capacitance development externally, boundaries protect stored potential from depletion.
5.desc: Keynote: Developed external joy needs defense; sincerity to disintegrating influences is dangerous.

6.name: Gate 58 Line 6 - Joy completion is seductive; full stored potential attracts — both light and shadow.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion of the standing wave — maximum external expression at Capacitance. "Seductive joyousness" = completion at -3 attracts. The stored potential fully expressed draws others to it. At Capacitance completion, the joy is so full it becomes magnetic — for better and worse.
6.desc: Keynote: Joy completion is seductive; full stored potential attracts — both light and shadow.

1.name: Gate 59 Line 1 - Entry to flowing depth; horse-strength help — the preemptive strike impregnates.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Current — first contact with flowing depth in a dematerialising gate. "Horse strength help, good fortune" = at +2 entry, powerful aid initiates the flow. Entry to current for dematerialisation brings fertility's power. At Current entry for dematerialisation, the preemptive strike uses fertility's power to impregnate.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to flowing depth; horse-strength help — the preemptive strike impregnates.

2.name: Gate 59 Line 2 - Developing at flowing depth; hurrying to support — shyness maintains separateness.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Current — building capacity in flowing depth. "At dissolution hurries to support, remorse disappears" = at +2 development, when boundaries dissolve, one seeks what sustains. Development at Current for dematerialisation requires finding support. At Current development, shyness restricts the drive to maintain separateness.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at flowing depth; hurrying to support — shyness maintains separateness.

3.name: Gate 59 Line 3 - Peak Current before crossing; dissolving the self — openness empowers through union.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Current — peak flowing depth before crossing. "Dissolves his self, no remorse" = at pre-threshold, the self dissolves to prepare for crossing. The release gate (-1) requires openness through self-dissolution. At +2 completion, empowerment comes through union and intimacy.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Current before crossing; dissolving the self — openness empowers through union.

4.name: Gate 59 Line 4 - Entry to release threshold; dissolving group bonds — dispersion enables accumulation.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Gate-OUT after crossing. "Dissolves group bond, supreme fortune, dispersion leads to accumulation" = at -1 entry, releasing group ties brings greatest fortune. Entry to release after crossing Current enables new accumulation. At Gate-OUT entry, brotherhood/sisterhood is achieved through releasing bonds.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to release threshold; dissolving group bonds — dispersion enables accumulation.

5.name: Gate 59 Line 5 - Developing at release threshold; cries dissolving like sweat — sexual power without blame.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Gate-OUT — building capacity in release threshold. "Loud cries dissolving like sweat, king abides blameless" = at -1 development, cathartic release through vocal expression. Development at Gate-OUT expresses dissolution powerfully. At Gate-OUT development, the archetype of sexual power (Femme Fatale/Casanova) operates.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at release threshold; cries dissolving like sweat — sexual power without blame.

6.name: Gate 59 Line 6 - Completion at release threshold; blood dissolved — the one night stand without blame.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Gate-OUT — the dematerialising journey complete. "Dissolves his blood, departing, distancing, going out, blameless" = at -1 completion, even blood ties dissolve. Complete release from all bonds. At Gate-OUT completion, the one night stand expresses sexual power without ongoing connection.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at release threshold; blood dissolved — the one night stand without blame.

1.name: Gate 60 Line 1 - Entry to stored potential; not going out brings no blame — acceptance handles limitation harmonically.

1.desc: Keynote: Entry to stored potential; not going out brings no blame — acceptance handles limitation harmonically.

2.name: Gate 60 Line 2 - Developing at stored potential; same limits now bring misfortune — decisiveness knows when to move.

Development at Capacitance requires knowing when limits must change. At Capacitance development, decisiveness operates without planetary support or hindrance.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at stored potential; same limits now bring misfortune — decisiveness knows when to move.

3.name: Gate 60 Line 3 - Peak Capacitance before crossing; no limitation brings lamentation — conservatism adapts but risks stuckness.

3.desc: Keynote: Peak Capacitance before crossing; no limitation brings lamentation — conservatism adapts but risks stuckness.

4.name: Gate 60 Line 4 - Entry to flowing form; contented limitation — resourcefulness maintains identity.

4.desc: Keynote: Entry to flowing form; contented limitation — resourcefulness maintains identity.

5.name: Gate 60 Line 5 - Developing at flowing form; sweet limitation — leadership maximizes potential within bounds.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Current — building capacity in flowing form. "Sweet limitation, good fortune, esteem" = at +2 development, limits become sweet and movement brings recognition. Development at Current maximizes potential within bounds. At Current development, leadership maximizes potential within limitation.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at flowing form; sweet limitation — leadership maximizes potential within bounds.

6.name: Gate 60 Line 6 - Completion at flowing form; galling limitation — rigidity over-constrains, let go.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Current — the manifesting journey complete. "Galling limitation, perseverance misfortune, remorse disappears" = at +2 completion, excessive limitation becomes painful. Persisting in what galls brings misfortune, but remorse (from letting go) disappears. At Current completion, rigidity represents limits that have become too harsh.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at flowing form; galling limitation — rigidity over-constrains, let go.

2.name: Gate 61 Line 2 - Developing at void storage; crane calls, young answers — natural brilliance inspires from depth.

2.desc: Keynote: Developing at void storage; crane calls, young answers — natural brilliance inspires from depth.

4.desc: Keynote: Entry to threshold pressure; moon nearly full, horse strays — research may forsake relationships.

5.name: Gate 61 Line 5 - Developing at threshold; truth links together — influence may be illusioned about collaboration.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Resistance — building capacity at threshold pressure. "Possesses truth that links together, no blame" = at -1 development, inner truth creates connection. Development at Resistance binds through authentic knowing. At Resistance development, influence may be illusioned that collaboration enhances inspiration.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at threshold; truth links together — influence may be illusioned about collaboration.

6.name: Gate 61 Line 6 - Completion at threshold; cockcrow to heaven — appeal may resent challenges and demands.

Complete arrival at threshold must release rather than persist. At Resistance completion, appeal may resent challenges and demands.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at threshold; cockcrow to heaven — appeal may resent challenges and demands.

1.name: Gate 62 Line 1 - Entry to building pressure; bird meets misfortune flying — routine organizes through fantasy.

Entry to building requires grounded routine, not ambitious flight. At Inductance entry, routine organizes detail through fantasy.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to building pressure; bird meets misfortune flying — routine organizes through fantasy.

2.name: Gate 62 Line 2 - Developing at building pressure; meet the ancestress and official — restraint disciplines detail work.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Inductance — building capacity in building pressure. "Passes ancestor, meets ancestress; not prince, meets official" = at +3 development, one reaches appropriate intermediate levels. Development at Inductance works through proper channels. At Inductance development, restraint provides discipline for detail work.
2.desc: Keynote: Developing at building pressure; meet the ancestress and official — restraint disciplines detail work.

3.name: Gate 62 Line 3 - Peak Inductance before transition; extreme care or struck from behind — discovery finds valuable details.
3.asc: Line 3 is completion at Inductance — peak building pressure before transition to gate-in. "Not extremely careful, struck from behind, misfortune" = at pre-transition, inattention invites attack. The movement to +1 requires extreme vigilance. At +3 completion, discovery finds and expresses valuable details.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak Inductance before transition; extreme care or struck from behind — discovery finds valuable details.

4.name: Gate 62 Line 4 - Entry to threshold; don't act, persevere — asceticism expresses after isolation.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Gate-IN after transition. "No blame, meets without passing, going dangerous, be on guard, don't act, persevere" = at +1 entry, stay put. Entry to threshold after Inductance requires stillness and isolation. At Gate-IN entry, asceticism expresses detail after isolation.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to threshold; don't act, persevere — asceticism expresses after isolation.

5.name: Gate 62 Line 5 - Developing at threshold; clouds ready but not raining — metamorphosis waits for complete details.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Gate-IN — building capacity at entry threshold. "Dense clouds no rain, prince shoots one in cave" = at +1 development, conditions are ready but haven't released; hidden targets can be reached. Development at Gate-IN builds toward expression. At Gate-IN development, metamorphosis waits until details complete.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing at threshold; clouds ready but not raining — metamorphosis waits for complete details.

6.name: Gate 62 Line 6 - Completion at threshold; don't pass by — self-discipline succeeds through detail.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Gate-IN — the material journey complete. "Passes without meeting, bird leaves, misfortune, bad luck and injury" = at +1 completion, overshooting brings disaster. Complete arrival at threshold must not exceed boundaries. At Gate-IN completion, self-discipline understands success depends on detail expression.
6.desc: Keynote: Completion at threshold; don't pass by — self-discipline succeeds through detail.

1.name: Gate 63 Line 1 - Entry to pressure; restrain the urge to discharge prematurely.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Voltage — first contact with pressure that will eventually discharge as current. "Braking wheels" = restraining the urge to rush. "Tail in water" = the crossing is beginning, but control is maintained. At -2 (Voltage), entry requires recognizing pressure without acting on it prematurely.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to pressure; restrain the urge to discharge prematurely.

2.name: Gate 63 Line 2 - Building pressure-structure; trust that what's lost during development returns.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Voltage — building the structure for the crossing. "Losing the curtain" = something drops away during development. "Don't chase it; it returns" = trust the development process. At -2, development means building pressure-capacity. What falls away will return when the crossing completes.
2.desc: Keynote: Building pressure-structure; trust that what's lost during development returns.

3.name: Gate 63 Line 3 - Peak pressure at threshold; sustained discipline for quality crossing.
3.asc: Line 3 is peak Voltage before crossing — maximum pressure before discharge. "Disciplining the devil's country" = the pre-threshold work is difficult. "Three years" = sustained effort. "Inferior people must not be employed" = the crossing requires quality. At -2 completion, pressure is maximum. The zero-crossing is imminent.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak pressure at threshold; sustained discipline for quality crossing.

4.name: Gate 63 Line 4 - Entry to flow reveals completion's imperfection; remember the lessons.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Current after crossing. "Finest clothes turn to rags" = what seemed complete at Voltage appears different at Current. "Be careful all day long" = the new state is vulnerable. After crossing from -2 to +2, the first contact with flow reveals imperfections in what was achieved.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to flow reveals completion's imperfection; remember the lessons.

5.name: Gate 63 Line 5 - Development in flow values sincerity over display.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Current — building capacity in flow. The east/west neighbor comparison: elaborate effort matters less than sincere presence. At +2, development isn't about more pressure — it's about quality of flow.
5.desc: Keynote: Development in flow values sincerity over display.

6.name: Gate 63 Line 6 - Complete immersion in flow; danger of losing or obsessing over origin.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Current — the crossing is fully done. "Head in water" = fully immersed in flow. "Danger" = complete immersion risks losing connection to what created the crossing (Voltage). At +2 completion, the danger is forgetting the origin or becoming obsessed with it.
6.desc: Keynote: Complete immersion in flow; danger of losing or obsessing over origin.

1.name: Gate 64 Line 1 - Entry to flow already beginning dissolution; find harmony in the awkward conditions.
1.asc: Line 1 is entry to Current — first contact with flow that will eventually dissolve. "Tail in water" (same image as Gate 63.1) but here "humiliating" — entry to flow in a dematerialising gate is awkward. You're entering what's about to dissolve. At +2 (Current), entry in Gate 64 means contacting flow while knowing dissolution is coming.
1.desc: Keynote: Entry to flow already beginning dissolution; find harmony in the awkward conditions.

2.name: Gate 64 Line 2 - Reducing flow-momentum; developing qualities needed for the crossing back.
2.asc: Line 2 is development at Current preparing for dematerialisation. "Braking wheels" = restraining flow. The same image appears in Gate 63.1, but here it's development at Current — slowing flow to prepare for return to Voltage. At +2, development for dematerialisation means reducing flow-momentum, preparing for pressure.
2.desc: Keynote: Reducing flow-momentum; developing qualities needed for the crossing back.

3.name: Gate 64 Line 3 - Peak flow before crossing; don't force, but prepare for the great crossing.
3.asc: Line 3 is peak Current before crossing — maximum flow before dematerialisation. "Attack brings misfortune" = don't force the crossing. "Crossing great water" = the zero-crossing is the goal, but timing matters. At +2 completion, flow is at maximum. The pressure for dematerialisation is building.
3.desc: Keynote: Peak flow before crossing; don't force, but prepare for the great crossing.

4.name: Gate 64 Line 4 - Entry to pressure; conviction that the crossing was right.
4.asc: Line 4 is entry to Voltage after crossing. "Perseverance brings good fortune" = having made the crossing, persistence is rewarded. "Remorse disappears" = doubts about the dematerialisation dissolve. "Three years" = sustained development at Voltage yields results. At -2 entry, the arrival at pressure after dissolving flow requires conviction.
4.desc: Keynote: Entry to pressure; conviction that the crossing was right.

5.name: Gate 64 Line 5 - Developing pressure that illuminates; the promise of what this crossing enables.
5.asc: Line 5 is development at Voltage — building pressure-capacity after the crossing. "Light of the superior man is true" = development at -2 (Fire/Voltage) is about illumination, clarity, pressure that illuminates. At Voltage, development means increasing capacity to hold potential difference — the promise of future flow.
5.desc: Keynote: Developing pressure that illuminates; the promise of what this crossing enables.

6.name: Gate 64 Line 6 - Victory complete; celebrate with restraint or lose everything.
6.asc: Line 6 is completion at Voltage — the dematerialising journey complete. "Drinking wine in confidence" = celebrating completion. "But wetting one's head = excess" = don't over-indulge at the peak. At -2 completion, Voltage is fully restored. The Flow axis crossing (from Current to Voltage) is done. But excess at completion inverts the achievement.
6.desc: Keynote: Victory complete; celebrate with restraint or lose everything.
